_comment_purpose: Org-managed settings that FORCE-ENABLE the inverita-guardrail plugin and its hook. Managed settings have the HIGHEST precedence in Claude Code and cannot be overridden by user (~/.claude) or project (.claude) settings. Keys prefixed with _comment_ are documentation only — delete them before deploying (they are ignored, but keep the file tidy).
_comment_enabledPlugins: Format is "<marketplace>/<plugin>". Here the marketplace is the org's plugin marketplace named 'inverita' and the plugin is 'inverita-guardrail'. Because this is set in MANAGED settings, developers cannot disable the plugin in their own settings — the setting is enforced, not merely defaulted.
_comment_allowManagedHooksOnly: REQUIRED for real enforcement. When true, Claude Code executes ONLY hooks that originate from managed settings / managed plugins and ignores hooks defined in user or project settings. Without this flag a developer could register a competing hook or otherwise interfere; with it, the guardrail hook is the authoritative UserPromptSubmit hook. This is the difference between 'recommended' and 'enforced'.
_comment_delivery_team_plan: DELIVERY OPTION A — Team/Enterprise plan admin console: Configure these managed settings in the Claude admin console and assign them to the PixelCare Health workspace/users. Managed settings delivered this way refresh on the client approximately hourly, so a developer who edits local settings has the managed policy re-applied on the next refresh. Good when you manage users through the Anthropic console and do not run device management.
_comment_delivery_mdm: DELIVERY OPTION B — MDM-pushed file at a SYSTEM-LEVEL path (recommended for hard enforcement): Push THIS file (with _comment_ keys removed) to the OS system path below via your MDM (Jamf, Intune, etc.). System paths are root/administrator-owned and NOT user-writable, so a developer-level session cannot edit or delete them to bypass the guard. Do NOT place managed settings in ~/.claude/ — that path is user-writable and therefore bypassable.
_comment_scope: This filters what is typed into Claude Code prompts. It is a client-side control and NOT a substitute for BAA/HIPAA-compliant upstream data handling. Real PHI must never be entered into any prompt regardless of this guard.
